action_items.action: Add checkout-path synthetic probing to the SLO signal.
Design immutable audit export for AWS and Azure.
Integrate workforce identity with approval verification.

contributing_factors: The basic health endpoint stayed green while the user-facing checkout path failed.
The experiment intentionally activated a local-only application fault mode.
detection: Incident Investigator Agent correlated a failed checkout request with the exported fault-mode metric.
impact: Local synthetic checkout requests returned HTTP 503. No production users or cloud resources were involved.
improvements: Add an external synthetic availability probe so a green process-health endpoint cannot hide checkout failure.
Export agent audit events to immutable cloud storage for production-grade retention.
Replace demo identities and the local approval secret with enterprise identity and KMS-backed signing.
resolution: checkout fault mode set to none
root_cause: local demo fault injection is set to errors
summary: Controlled checkout failure exercised SentinelSRE detection, governance, recovery, and verification.

timeline.detail: fault mode is none; health endpoint returned HTTP 200

what_went_well: Runtime evidence identified the injected mode without granting the investigator mutation access.
Unauthorized and unapproved paths were denied before execution.
The approved adapter restored service and verified both fault state and health.
